posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
I feel like maybe there should be such a thing, as we're collecting more and more shows and showrunners who want feedback on them.

Current Lineup:

Sentinels Live on Tuesdays at 7PM ET. The usual weekly Let's Play with Jeremy and John and occasional guests just playing the game, talking about beardcare and geeky things, and sometimes showing off previews of upcoming content.

Dolphin's Dive on Thursdays at 7PM ET. Dealing with strategies and how to best play the game. Pattern right now is that first game is LewdDolphin's choice, second game is viewer's choice, third is totally random.

Tales from the Archive on Saturdays at 7PM ET. Taking Sentinels card games and spinning them into a way to tell stories with the cards. Very RPG campaign-esque.

Future Lineup:

There was a Dev Stream this past Friday at 1PM ET. MigrantP wants to make it a regular thing and bring in other Handelabra folks to show off their workflow, but don't know what the eventual standard day and time will be. This one's not always Sentinels; MigrantP worked on Bottom of the 9th development this time around.

I feel kind of annoyed that my Twitch app didn't throw me up a notification about the Friday stream so I lost track of time since I was out during the morning, and I forgot about it. :P Bad Twitch.

Yeah, I wouldn't mind getting to show off Sentinels to a bigger audience. (Sadly I don't have any suggestions, as I tend to be pretty game-specific in what Let's Plays I watch.) I wonder if the Shacknews attempt garnered much extra interest; the chat population seemed to mostly be our own fandom TBH.

I agree it'd be great to get a streamer who actually features in playing card games and pimping things to people who specifically play card games. It's been established elsewhere on the forum that there's a number of previous/current Magic players who find Sentinels fits nicely into those same gaming itches, and I'd wager other CCG or deckbuilding players would feel the same way if they tried/saw it.

I do weekly one-shots on my YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLiSuxYut3xCkEBRAqzwdGFKF_wKt8CTiV). I don't do them live because I like approaching them with zero knowledge of how other people fared; in the past, people said things in my live chat like "Watch out, Devastating Aurora is coming up" which ruins honest strategy-making.

That said, there are a couple early one-shots that I don't have recordings for (I only started recording with #9, and I went back and did 1-6 at some point) so I'm willing to entertain the possibility of playing through those, if people want it. :)
